channel.title: Sourced Daily
channel.description: Four desks. Every claim linked to where it came from.

item.title: Praxist: an autonomous research system that ships mostly as worked examples
item.description: Praxist from sapientinc is a Python system for coordinating parallel agent-driven research on projects whose objective is already measurable. Its repository layout is unusual enough to matter: the engine is a small fraction of the tree, and the examples are the product surface most readers will actually touch.

item.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: reading the config of a hybrid-attention multimodal preview
item.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is an open-weight image-text-to-text model published as a Transformers-format repository, built on an architecture Qwen describes as an experimental preview of what will underpin Qwen4. This is for engineers deciding whether to pull 131 weight shards onto a machine, and who want to know what the config file commits them to before they do.

item.title: DeepSeek Harness: an agent runtime where the plugin graph is the product
item.description: DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an MIT-licensed, TypeScript agent harness from DeepSeek AI, built on the Cordis plugin framework and shipped as a large monorepo. If you are evaluating agent runtimes to build on rather than just run, the way this repository is partitioned tells you more than the README does.

item.title: GLM-5.3: what a 141-shard GlmMoeDsa checkpoint actually ships
item.description: GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's open-weights text-generation model, a mixture-of-experts architecture with a learned sparse-attention indexer, distributed as 141 safetensors shards under a custom licence. This is for engineers deciding whether to pull it, host it, or fine-tune it, and who want to know how the repository is organised before committing the bandwidth.

item.title: DSH Desktop: an Electron-era plugin host where the desktop shell is itself a plugin
item.description: anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop is a community-built Windows and macOS client that wraps DeepSeek Harness's local web UI, host service, and plugin system in a native app. It matters if you are evaluating plugin-host architectures, or considering shipping a plugin into someone else's desktop runtime.

item.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: reading a hybrid linear/sparse-attention multimodal release from its config
item.description: GLM-5.3-Flash is zai-org's first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, published on Hugging Face under MIT with an image-text-to-text pipeline tag and a new architecture class, Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration. If you are deciding whether to serve or fine-tune it, the config file tells you more about the deployment shape than the model card does.
